# Albero Innovation

> SkillAI provides online skill assessments, AI interview practice, resume tools, research discovery, and career guidance.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://albero-innovation.in/): Overview of SkillAI's learning and career tools.
- [Plans and pricing](https://albero-innovation.in/pricing/): Compare available SkillAI plans.
- [Contact](https://albero-innovation.in/contact/): Contact the team for help, feedback, or partnership enquiries.
- [Student resume builder](https://albero-innovation.in/resume-builder/): Create and export a student or early-career resume.
- [AI interview practice](https://albero-innovation.in/ai-interview/): Practice role-focused and behavioral interview questions.
- [Research paper finder](https://albero-innovation.in/research-assistant/): Search scholarly papers and explore available abstracts.
- [Resume job description matcher](https://albero-innovation.in/jd-match/): Compare resume content with a job description.
